enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Remain still. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Move legs. Turn onto back. Sleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing face, brushing teeth, and showering to get ready for the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on faucet. Adjust water temperature. Wash face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn on shower. Wash body. Dry with towel. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast using the toaster and kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Remove toast. Spread butter. Pour hot water into mug. Sit and eat.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed in work clothes and checking shift notes on the Computer
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work clothes. Remove pajamas. Put on work clothes. Walk to desk. Turn on computer. Open shift notes. Read notes. Turn off computer. Exit bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the morning shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of bedroom. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Open front door. Walk out. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, providing patient care and updating clinical records
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Check patient list. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update patient records. Assist patient with mobility. Respond to call bell. Consult with doctor. Take notes. Enter next patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update patient records. Assist patient with mobility. Prepare handover notes.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Sit at table. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Clear tray. Return tray. Walk back to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing patient care duties and handover preparation
enriched_activities.desc: Wash hands. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update patient records. Assist patient with mobility. Respond to call bell. Consult with doctor. Take notes. Enter next patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update patient records. Prepare handover notes. Attend handover meeting. Report patient status. Listen to colleagues. Take notes.
Walk out of hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house. Take off shoes. Put down bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing hands and freshening up after returning home
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on faucet. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Splash water on face. Dry face and hands with towel. Turn off faucet. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner using the induction cooker and range hood
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Wash and chop vegetables. Turn on range hood. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil and ingredients. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Turn off range hood.
Sit at table. Pick up fork. Cut food. Lift food to mouth. Chew. Swallow. Pick up glass. Drink water. Continue eating. Finish meal. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up dishes and wiping down the counter
enriched_activities.desc: Collect dishes. Scrape food into trash. Turn on faucet. Wash dishes. Rinse dishes. Place dishes in drying rack. Turn off faucet. Wipe counter. Wipe table. Turn off light. Exit kitchen.

Enter living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on sofa. Press channel button. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Exit living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the Computer for personal admin and reviewing health care study material
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on computer. Open email. Check messages. Open bank website. Pay bills. Close bank website. Open study material. Read. Take notes. Highlight text. Review questions. Close study material. Turn off computer. Stand up. Exit living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash, brushing teeth, and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on faucet. Wash face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off faucet. Dry face with towel. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.
Enter bedroom. Turn off light. Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Remain still. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Move legs. Turn onto back. Sleep.
